content.en_us:
How to get it :
- Crafting table : 6 x [[gv:nugget_sr90|Strontium-90 Nugget]].
- Crafting table (x3) : 2 x [[gv:ingot_sr90|Strontium-90 Ingot]].

Used to make :
[[gv:ingot_sr90|Strontium-90 Ingot]], [[gv:nugget_sr90|Strontium-90 Nugget]], [[gv:pellet_rtg_strontium|Strontium-90 RTG Pellet]].
